Aatrox.notes: Pro staple top; drain-tank fighter who wins extended fights with Q sweet spots and R healing.

Ahri.notes: Safe blind mid; charm picks and R dashes for roams, skirmishes and flexible AP threat.

Akali.notes: Mid/top flex assassin; shroud makes her slippery in skirmishes; picked into low point-click CC.

Akshan.notes: Niche mid/top counterpick; roaming marksman-assassin who revives allies on takedowns.

Alistar.notes: Engage/peel tank support; W-Q combo initiates or disengages, R makes him an unkillable frontline.

Ambessa.notes: Top/mid flex diver; chained dashes and R lockdown let her dive backlines and win skirmishes.

Amumu.notes: Teamfight engage jungle/support; bandage tosses and AoE R stun for wombo combos.

Anivia.notes: Zone-control mage; wall splits fights and stalls sieges, egg passive gives safety, scales late.

Annie.notes: Occasional mid/support; flash-Tibbers stun engage and point-click burst for pick comps.

Aphelios.notes: Pro hypercarry ADC; weapon rotation gives massive teamfight DPS late, weak early and immobile.

Ashe.notes: Utility ADC/support; global R arrow for picks and engage, constant slows and hawkshot vision.

AurelionSol.notes: Stacking scaling mage; weak early but dominates late teamfights with breath AoE and R knockup.

Aurora.notes: Mid/top flex mage; spirit-realm W and R zone trap make her safe and strong in skirmishes.

Azir.notes: Pro favorite scaling mid; soldiers give safe sustained DPS and siege, R shuffle engages or peels.

Bard.notes: Roaming support; chimes and portals create map pressure, Q stun picks and R sets up engages.

Belveth.notes: Farming hypercarry jungler; fast clears, void coral from objectives, dominates late side lanes.

Blitzcrank.notes: Hook catcher; one landed grab decides fights, risky to blind because minions block hooks.

Brand.notes: AoE damage mage played support/jungle; fast clear and huge teamfight damage, but immobile.

Braum.notes: Protective warden; shield blocks projectiles and passive stun wins 2v2 lanes; strong vs dive.

Briar.notes: Early aggressive jungler; frenzy W self-heal and global R engage, falls off and hard to control.

Caitlyn.notes: Range bully ADC; traps and long range win lane and take towers fast in siege comps.

Camille.notes: Top diver/splitpusher; hookshot and R isolate carries; occasionally flexed to support.

Cassiopeia.notes: Sustained-DPS mage; poison and E spam shred frontlines, R stun turns fights; immobile.

Chogath.notes: Scaling tank top; R stacks HP and true damage secures objectives, Q/W CC for teamfights.

Corki.notes: Poke mid; missiles and package timing give siege and flank threat with mixed damage scaling.

Darius.notes: Lane-bully juggernaut; dominates early trades and resets R in fights, but kiteable and immobile.

Diana.notes: AP diver jungle/mid; R pull dives backlines for AoE engages, solid clear speed.

DrMundo.notes: Unkillable scaling tank; soaks damage and grinds sides, low CC so needs teammates to engage.

Draven.notes: Snowball lane-bully ADC; axes and adoration gold reward early kills, needs a lead to carry.

Ekko.notes: AP jungle/mid skirmisher; W zone stun in fights, R rewind for survivability and burst.

Elise.notes: Early-game ganking jungler; cocoon dives and tower dives, falls off hard in late game.

Evelynn.notes: Stealth assassin jungler post-6; picks off carries but weak pre-6 and in front-to-back fights.

Ezreal.notes: Safe blind ADC; Q poke and E blink make him hard to catch; fits poke and siege comps.

Fiddlesticks.notes: Flank engage jungler; Crowstorm from fog wins teamfights, fear and drain, effigy vision tricks.

Fiora.notes: Premier side-lane duelist; vitals true damage and riposte win 1v1s and apply splitpush pressure.

Fizz.notes: Burst assassin mid; untargetable E dodges key spells, shark R picks off squishies.

Galio.notes: Mid/support flex tank-mage; global R joins fights, taunt engage, strong vs AP-heavy comps.

Gangplank.notes: Scaling top; barrel crits wipe fights, global R aids skirmishes; weak to early dives.

Garen.notes: Rare pro juggernaut; spin damage and execute R, tanky but limited CC and range.

Gnar.notes: Flexible top; kites in mini form, Mega Gnar R wall-stun engages teamfights; safe blind.

Gragas.notes: Highly flexible tank-mage; body slam and R displacement for engage, isolation and peel.

Graves.notes: Carry farming jungler; fast clears, invades and close-range burst in skirmishes.

Gwen.notes: Scaling AP skirmisher; mist blocks ranged damage, %HP true damage shreds tanks.

Hecarim.notes: Mobile diver jungler; fast clear, E charge ganks, R fear engages onto backlines.

Heimerdinger.notes: Turret-zone lane bully support/mid; dominates 2v2 lanes and sieges, very low mobility.

Hwei.notes: Versatile mid/support mage; long-range poke, zone control and fear/root picks; immobile.

Illaoi.notes: Zone juggernaut; tentacles and R dominate chokes and 1v2s, but immobile with a dodgeable E.

Irelia.notes: Mid/top skirmisher-diver; Q resets and stun let her dive and chain resets in fights.

Ivern.notes: Utility jungler; free camps, shields and Daisy give lane help and peel, low personal threat.

Janna.notes: Disengage enchanter; tornado and R stop dives, shields buff carries, weak vs ranged poke.

JarvanIV.notes: Engage jungler; EQ knockup and Cataclysm trap targets; strong early ganks and dragon fights.

Jax.notes: Scaling duelist top/jungle; Counter Strike and leap dives, top-tier splitpusher late game.

Jayce.notes: Poke lane bully top/mid; accelerated Q siege and hammer burst, falls off late.

Jhin.notes: Utility ADC; long-range W root and R picks enable catch comps, bursty 4th shot.

Jinx.notes: Hypercarry ADC; Get Excited resets in teamfights, rockets siege; immobile and dive-prone.

KSante.notes: Pro staple tank top; W/R isolate targets, All Out turns him into a skirmisher; very blind-safe.

Kaisa.notes: Mobile hypercarry ADC; evolves abilities with items, R follows up dives onto marked carries.

Kalista.notes: Early bully ADC; Rend secures drakes/barons, R saves and engages with support; falls off.

Karma.notes: Flexible lane-bully enchanter; empowered Q poke, shield speedups for engage or disengage.

Karthus.notes: Farming AP jungler; fastest clears, global R snipes and huge AoE DPS in teamfights.

Kassadin.notes: Late-game monster; weak early, Riftwalk spam at 16 makes him a slippery backline threat.

Katarina.notes: Reset assassin; rare in pro, cleans up fights with Shunpo resets but easily stopped by CC.

Kayle.notes: Hyperscaling top; very weak early, ranged AoE DPS at 11/16, R makes an ally invulnerable.

Kayn.notes: Form-based jungler; Rhaast drains frontlines or Shadow Assassin picks; wall-walk ganks.

Kennen.notes: Teamfight top; flash-R AoE stun engages from flanks, ranged lane harass.

Khazix.notes: Isolation assassin jungler; evolved leaps pick off isolated targets, strong invades.

Kindred.notes: Ranged carry jungler; marks scale damage, invade-oriented, Lamb's Respite saves teamfights.

Kled.notes: Aggressive top; dismount mechanics win lanes, R charge engages his whole team across the map.

KogMaw.notes: Protect-the-carry hyperscaler; W melts frontlines behind enchanters, immobile and weak early.

Leblanc.notes: Pick assassin mid; W-R mobility and chains catch targets, strong roams, falls off late.

LeeSin.notes: Early playmaker jungler; ward-hop mobility, insec kicks and strong invades, falls off late.

Leona.notes: All-in engage support; E-Q lockdown and AoE R stun; kill lanes with aggressive ADCs.

Lillia.notes: Kiting AP jungler; very fast clear, sustained AoE damage and sleep R for teamfights.

Lissandra.notes: Engage control mage; claw-in R lockdown, self-R for safety, strong anti-dive and roams.

Locke.notes: New AP melee assassin; nail marks and E resets, R execute totem snowballs; safe W trading.

Lucian.notes: Short-range lane-bully ADC; pairs with enchanters, dash-weaving burst trades; falls off late.

Lulu.notes: Premier peel enchanter; polymorph and Wild Growth protect hypercarries, strong lane harass.

Lux.notes: Pick/poke mage mid/support; long root and laser R, low mobility but long range.

Malphite.notes: Unstoppable R engage tank top/support; picked vs AD-heavy comps for wombo engages.

Malzahar.notes: Safe push mage; voidlings shove waves, point-click R suppression for picks and dive targets.

Maokai.notes: Flex engage tank; W root, saplings for vision control and R zone; strong blind pick.

MasterYi.notes: Farm-and-reset hypercarry; Alpha Strike dodges and cleans up fights, rare in pro due to CC.

Mel.notes: Mid/support mage; long-range poke, W reflect denies engages, global R execute on stacked targets.

Milio.notes: Enchanter for range carries; W range/heal and R cleanse enable front-to-back fights.

MissFortune.notes: Lane-strong ADC; Bullet Time wins wombo teamfights, Q bounce poke; needs engage around her.

MonkeyKing.notes: Engage diver jungle/top; double Cyclone knockup wins teamfights, clone baits cooldowns.

Mordekaiser.notes: Juggernaut top; R isolates a carry in the death realm, E pull; immobile and kiteable.

Morgana.notes: Catcher support; long Q root picks, Black Shield protects engagers or carries from CC.

Naafiri.notes: Roaming AD assassin; packs push lanes and dive, R reveals targets for picks.

Nami.notes: Aggressive enchanter; empowers lane-bully ADCs, bubble picks and wave for engage/disengage.

Nasus.notes: Stacking scaling top; weak lane but Q stacks make him a splitpush threat, Wither cripples carries.

Nautilus.notes: Point-click CC engage support; hook, passive root and R chain lockdown; reliable picks.

Neeko.notes: Mid/support flex mage; disguise baits, root and AoE R stun for flank engages.

Nidalee.notes: Early tempo jungler; fast clear, invades and spear poke; must snowball before falling off.

Nilah.notes: Melee ADC; dashes in with enchanters, W dodges autos, R pull for AoE teamfights.

Nocturne.notes: Dive jungler; Paranoia R darkens vision for ganks and backline dives, spell shield vs CC.

Nunu.notes: Objective-control tank jungler; Consume smites objectives, snowball ganks and AoE R.

Olaf.notes: Early-game berserker; R CC immunity lets him run down carries, falls off late.

Orianna.notes: Premier blind-pick control mage; ball shields engagers, Shockwave decides teamfights.

Ornn.notes: Pro staple tank top; free item upgrades, double-R and brittle knockups for frontline engage.

Pantheon.notes: Early flex pick; point-click stun and long-range R for roams/dives, falls off late.

Poppy.notes: Flex warden; W stops dashes, E wall stun and R knockback for engage or disengage.

Pyke.notes: Assassin support; hook picks, roams and execute R resets share gold; weak front-to-back.

Qiyana.notes: Engage assassin; terrain R stun can wipe teams in jungle chokes, strong roams.

Quinn.notes: Ranged top counterpick; lane bully with R roams and splitpush, weak in late teamfights.

Rakan.notes: Mobile engage support; W knockup and R charm initiate fights, E to carry for peel.

Rammus.notes: Anti-AD tank jungler; Powerball ganks and taunt; counterpick vs auto-attack heavy comps.

RekSai.notes: Early skirmish jungler; tunnels and unburrow knockup ganks, tremor sense tracking.

Rell.notes: Hard engage support; W crash-down and R magnet storm pull whole teams into wombo fights.

Renata.notes: Teamfight enchanter; Bailout revives carries, Hostile Takeover R turns enemy dives into chaos.

Renekton.notes: Lane-bully top diver; empowered W stun and double dash enable dives; falls off late.

Rengar.notes: Bush-leap assassin; one-shots isolated carries, R hunt reveals targets for picks.

Riven.notes: Mobile skirmisher top; triple Q and W stun chains, strong snowballer and side-lane threat.

Rumble.notes: Flex battlemage; Equalizer R zones teamfights and objectives, strong lane with heat management.

Ryze.notes: Scaling battlemage; root and spell-spam DPS, Realm Warp R enables team flanks and rotations.

Samira.notes: All-in ADC; follows Rell/Nautilus engages, Wind Wall blocks projectiles, R shreds clumped fights.

Sejuani.notes: Pro-favorite tank jungler; frost-stun engage with melee allies, R picks, reliable frontline.

Senna.notes: Scaling marksman support; souls stack range and crit, long Q poke/heal and global R shield.

Seraphine.notes: Flex mage-enchanter; AoE heal/shield and long-range charm R for teamfights, often APC bot.

Sett.notes: Brawler top/support; E stun and suplex R engage, Haymaker true damage punishes dives.

Shaco.notes: Trickster assassin; boxes for invades and fear, clone baits; rare pro counterpick.

Shen.notes: Global presence tank; Stand United R joins fights anywhere, taunt engage, splitpush pressure.

Shyvana.notes: Farming dragon-focused jungler; fast clear and drake control, dragon-form AoE in teamfights.

Singed.notes: Proxy-farm specialist top; fling disruption and splitpush pressure, rare pro counterpick.

Sion.notes: Tank top; Q knockup and R charge engage, stacks HP and pushes waves; safe blind frontline.

Sivir.notes: Waveclear utility ADC; spell shield safety, ricochet AoE and R team speed for engage/disengage.

Skarner.notes: Tank jungler; E wall-drag and R suppression grab carries, strong picks and engage.

Smolder.notes: Stacking hyperscaler ADC/mid/top; Q stacks to a 225 execute burn, wants long games.

Sona.notes: Scaling enchanter; aura heals and speed, Crescendo AoE stun; fragile and immobile.

Soraka.notes: Healer support; sustains poke comps with global R heal, low engage and vulnerable to dives.

Swain.notes: Drain-tank battlemage flex; E pull picks, Demonic Ascension R tanks and sustains in fights.

Sylas.notes: Mid/top skirmisher; steals enemy ultimates (often engage R), chain dash and heal in fights.

Syndra.notes: Lane-dominant burst mage; QE stun and R one-shots carries, strong anti-dive zoning.

TahmKench.notes: Bot-lane bully support/top; Devour saves carries, grey-health tankiness and R roams.

Taliyah.notes: Roaming mage jungle/mid; Weaver's Wall R splits fights and enables cross-map ganks.

Talon.notes: Roaming AD assassin; wall-hop parkour ganks and skirmishes, picks off squishy carries.

Taric.notes: Protective tank support; Cosmic Radiance invulnerability flips fights, E stun with linked ally.

Teemo.notes: Counterpick specialist top; blind and shrooms control vision and chokes, poor in teamfights.

Thresh.notes: Versatile catcher support; hook picks, lantern saves and flay peel; strong blind pick.

Tristana.notes: Mobile ADC/mid; E-bomb all-ins and fast turret takes, jump resets and scaling range.

Trundle.notes: Anti-tank juggernaut; R steals tank stats, pillar for picks and fast tower/objective takes.

Tryndamere.notes: Splitpush specialist; crit duelist that takes towers fast, R delays death; weak to CC.

TwistedFate.notes: Global roaming mid; Destiny R creates cross-map plays, gold card picks; flexes to bot.

Twitch.notes: Stealth hypercarry ADC; flanks from invisibility with R spray, occasionally roaming support.

Udyr.notes: Stance-swapping jungle/top; fast clears and objective control, bear-stance stun ganks.

Urgot.notes: Ranged juggernaut; shotgun-knee DPS and E flip, R execute fears teams; immobile.

Varus.notes: Flex poke ADC/mid; Q siege poke, R root chain for picks and engage.

Vayne.notes: Tank-shredding hypercarry; Silver Bolts true damage and tumble stealth; weak early, short range.

Veigar.notes: Stacking scaling mage; Event Horizon cage zones engages, R one-shots late; very immobile.

Velkoz.notes: Artillery mage support/mid; true-damage passive poke and long-range Q/E picks.

Vex.notes: Anti-dash burst mage; Gloom fear punishes divers, R double-dash engages for picks.

Vi.notes: Point-click R diver jungler; locks down a carry, reliable ganks and Q engage.

Viego.notes: Reset skirmisher jungler; possesses enemies after kills, chains fights and steals kits.

Viktor.notes: Scaling zone mage; laser waveclear and gravity field zoning, huge AoE in late teamfights.

Vladimir.notes: Scaling drain mage; pool dodges key CC, AoE R burst in teamfights; weak early.

Volibear.notes: Early-strong diver top/jungle; Q stun ganks and R tower-disabling dives.

Warwick.notes: Blood Hunt tracking diver; fast clear, R suppression ganks and sustain in skirmishes.

Xayah.notes: Self-peel hypercarry; R untargetability dodges engages, feather root recall wins teamfights.

Xerath.notes: Artillery mage; extreme-range Q/R poke for siege comps, very vulnerable to dives.

XinZhao.notes: Early skirmish jungler; three-hit knockup ganks, R zone and anti-ranged shield in fights.

Yasuo.notes: Knockup-synergy skirmisher; follows wombo comps with Last Breath, Wind Wall blocks projectiles.

Yone.notes: Scaling skirmisher mid/top; R engages multiple targets, E soul return gives safe dives.

Yorick.notes: Side-lane siege specialist; ghouls and Maiden take towers fast, cage traps duelists.

Yunara.notes: Auto-attack hypercarry ADC; on-hit scaling and empowered R form for front-to-back fights.

Yuumi.notes: Attached enchanter; heals and buffs a carry from safety, low agency vs strong engage.

Zaahen.notes: Darkin fighter top/jungle; W pull and Q knockup, R slam dive, passive revive at full stacks.

Zac.notes: Long-range E slingshot engage tank; blob sustain and R bounces disrupt backlines.

Zed.notes: Shadow assassin; energy poke and Death Mark one-shot squishies, splitpush pressure; rare pro.

Zeri.notes: Mobile hypercarry; wall-hopping E and R speed for kiting, best with enchanter shields.

Ziggs.notes: Siege artillery mage, often played bot; satchels and turret execute take towers, long poke.

Zilean.notes: Utility support; double-bomb stun, speed/slow tempo and Chronoshift revive protects carries.

Zoe.notes: Long-range pick mage; bubble sleep into paddle star one-shots, poke and spell steals.

Zyra.notes: Plant-zone mage support/jungle; root and R knockup for teamfights, strong lane damage.
